evidence.title: Video Background Remover: Remove video backgrounds | Canva

name: Canva Video Background Remover
summary: Canva Pro tool that removes a video's background in one click so the subject can sit on a new scene.
description: Upload a video, run Background Remover from the toolbar to mask the subject across all frames, then replace the background with an uploaded image or a template and download an MP4. Works without a green screen and requires Canva Pro; unscreen.com now redirects to this Canva feature page.
contains: removes a video background in one click by masking the subject across all frames
replace the background with an uploaded image or a Canva template
exports high-quality MP4; part of Canva's video editor
unscreen.com now redirects to this Canva feature page
